Now I understand the test. Only `data_samples()` is actually used by the single `@ParameterizedTest`; the other 10+ data-provider methods and many imports are dead code that obscure what the test does. I'll keep the exact same method calls and arguments while making it readable.Compiles cleanly. I improved understandability by removing the 10+ unused data-provider methods and dead imports, splitting the single dense `data_samples` line into one readable case per row with grouping comments (epoch, leap-year insertion, 400-year cycle edges, BCE years), adding explanatory Javadoc, and renaming the test parameters to `expectedPaxDate`/`isoDate` — all while preserving the exact same `PaxDate.from(iso)` assertion with identical arguments.
